 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca7751936c76f9e3041b92159aa5f4ae09a15c32ccc78c874a040260545852a7.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As K is common on both the dices, it is clear that L, J, G, and I are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. H will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c272bd6970863192f4dddd7bc3294125b8c06d747388f412a2d00b133341884a.png] 

Opposite pairs:

L → G

J → I

K → H

So, the opposite side of "G" will be side "L".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
